1.consolidated_definition: inform. Se dice del disco que permite iniciar el sistema operativo de una computadora. Anglicismo crudo, frecuente. Un live CD o CD vivo es una distribución de un sistema operativo que funciona desde un disco compacto bootable, es decir, que es capaz de activar el sistema operativo que contiene sin instalarlo en el disco duro (Techno4all, blog, 27-07-05)
1.en_consolidated_definition: Bootable CD or Live CD: Informally referred to as a disc that enables the startup of a computer's operating system. This term is an anglicism and is frequently used. A live CD or bootable CD is a distribution of an operating system that functions from a compact disc, capable of activating the contained operating system without installing it on the hard drive (Techno4all, blog, 27-07-05).
